description: Full-scale replica mounted on poles at the highway corner, built by the Cunderdin Historical Society as a memorial to No. 9 Elementary Flying Training School which operated at Cunderdin aerodrome in the 1940s. Wears the markings M-2005 and has also been recorded as VH-WLQ and CN-1.
aliases: DH82; DH82A; Tiger Moth; M-2005; CN-1; CN1
